components.name: findings
components.detail: 100 - 156 penalty over 14 distinct problem type(s) across 40 significant finding(s) (Critical 14, High 13, Medium 13)

components.name: convergence
components.detail: target 0.001; per period: HWY_ASSIGN AM: gap 0.0200 -> 0; HWY_ASSIGN EV: gap 0.0005 -> 100; HWY_ASSIGN MD: gap 0.0005 -> 100; HWY_ASSIGN NT: gap 0.0005 -> 100; HWY_ASSIGN PM: gap 0.0005 -> 100

definition: Health = 0.7 x Findings component + 0.3 x Convergence component. Findings component = max(0, 100 - 25 x Critical - 8 x High - 2 x Medium - 0 x Info), counting each distinct problem type (a check and the issue it found) once, at its worst significant severity: a coding error repeated on 8,000 links is one problem. Convergence component = 100 if every assignment period met the relative gap target, scaled down linearly to 0 at ten times the target. When a run has no convergence data, the findings component carries the full weight. Grade: A >= 90, B >= 75, C >= 60, D >= 40, E below 40.
